name: Corvallis
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Corvallis, OR 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Corvallis, Oregon for 2026: a holiday parade, a Nutcracker, a craft fair and more, with dates and prices checked.
lede: Corvallis is a college town in the Willamette Valley that celebrates with a downtown holiday parade, a community band concert, a children's craft fair and a Nutcracker staged by local dancers.
celebrates: Downtown Corvallis hosts the holiday parade, and the downtown association lists it as a community tradition on its events calendar. The Corvallis Community Band plays a winter concert each December, and the Corvallis Ballet Collective stages the Nutcracker with local dancers. The Corvallis-Benton County Public Library runs family programs through its event calendar, and Oregon State University's research forests invite families to Peavy Arboretum for a winter solstice gathering. Local service groups such as Rotary also run children's craft events.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for Corvallis holiday events, so this page leans on the hosts' own pages. The downtown association and the community band both describe their holiday events as annual ones, and the Corvallis Ballet Collective presents its Nutcracker as a yearly production with local dancers.
facts: Corvallis is the home of Oregon State University and the county seat of Benton County. The Nutcracker began as a ballet in 1892 with music by Tchaikovsky, and many communities now stage it every December. Peavy Arboretum is part of the Oregon State University research forests, which use the forests for teaching and research.
trains: Corvallis does not have its own holiday train that we could verify. Families who want train fun usually head east to the Oregon Electric Railway Museum at Powerland Heritage Park in Brooks, which is listed on our museum guide.
train_links: A railway museum at Powerland Heritage Park, listed on our museum guide.

faq: Downtown Corvallis holds a holiday parade, the community band plays a winter concert, local dancers stage the Nutcracker, and the library and local groups run crafts and cookie decorating. Many of these events are free or low cost, and our listings link to each host.
Is there a Christmas parade in Corvallis?
Yes. The Downtown Corvallis Holiday Parade is organized by the downtown association and is a public parade that is free to watch. Check our listing for the date and time.
Is there a Nutcracker in Corvallis?
Yes. The Corvallis Ballet Collective presents the Nutcracker with local dancers at Ashbrook Independent School. Our listing has dates, times and the host's ticket page.
Are there free Christmas events for kids in Corvallis?
Yes. Several of our Corvallis listings are free, including the parade, a children's craft fair, a winter solstice gathering and a community band concert. Some need registration, so read each listing.
Where can kids decorate cookies in Corvallis?
The Corvallis-Benton County Public Library lists a cookie decorating party on its event calendar. Our listing links to the library page for the time and any sign-up details.
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Corvallis for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 4 of them free. The fun runs from December 4 (the Cookie Decorating Party at the Corvallis Library) through December 20 (the Corvallis Nutcracker at Ashbrook Independent School), with the Rotary Children's Holiday Craft Fair (December 5), the Downtown Corvallis Holiday Parade (December 6), the Winter Solstice Celebration at Peavy Arboretum and the Winter Dreams Holiday Concert (both December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Corvallis

  • 6 Christmas events for kids in Corvallis
  • 4 free events, including the Downtown Corvallis Holiday Parade, the Rotary Children's Holiday Craft Fair, the Winter Solstice Celebration at Peavy Arboretum and the Winter Dreams Holiday Concert
  • Parades and music: the Downtown Corvallis Holiday Parade (December 6) and the Winter Dreams Holiday Concert by the Corvallis Community Band (December 12)
  • Crafts and treats: the Rotary Children's Holiday Craft Fair (December 5, register each child) and the Cookie Decorating Party at the Corvallis Library (December 4)
  • On stage: the Corvallis Nutcracker at Ashbrook Independent School (December 18 to 20), with a Mouse King Tea Party on December 19
  • Season: December 4 to December 20
